description: Guidelines that describe what good development looks like in a particular place, and the review process that applies them consistently.
scope_notes: This is a standard-practice starting point — edit to your scope. Rename, delete and add records until the list matches the work your agency actually agreed to do.

Every date is calculated forward from the kickoff date you enter. The offsets are round numbers reflecting how this kind of work is usually sequenced — they are placeholders for a real schedule, not commitments.
Guidelines that cannot be applied consistently by a reviewer are decoration. The review-process deliverable is what turns them into practice, and it is where most of the argument belongs.
Whether guidelines are advisory or binding is a local decision with real legal consequences. This template does not assume either — state which yours are in the document itself.

No jurisdiction is assumed. Review periods, required notices, hearings and the body that adopts the work are set where you are; none of them are stated here. Add the records your own process requires.
Nobody is assigned. Applying a template never puts a colleague's name on a deadline — assign the records yourself once the team is settled.

deliverables.title: Context study
deliverables.summary: The building types, streets, materials, setbacks and patterns already present, documented before anything is prescribed.

deliverables.title: Guideline framework and organization
deliverables.summary: How the guidelines will be structured and which areas or building types each part covers.

deliverables.title: Illustrated draft guidelines
deliverables.summary: The guidelines with the images and diagrams that make them usable by an applicant.

deliverables.title: Design review process recommendations
deliverables.summary: Who reviews what, against which criteria, at which stage, and how a decision may be appealed.

deliverables.title: Public review draft
deliverables.summary: The complete draft guidelines and process released for comment.

milestones.title: Project kickoff meeting
milestones.summary: Scope, the area covered and the intended legal status confirmed.

milestones.title: Walking tour and community workshop
milestones.summary: The context studied on foot with the people who live and build there.

milestones.title: Advisory body workshop on the draft
milestones.summary: The body that will apply the guidelines tests them against real applications.

milestones.title: Public review of the draft opens
milestones.summary: The draft is released for comment.

milestones.title: Adoption of the guidelines
milestones.summary: Adoption by the body whose adoption gives the guidelines their standing.
